Notes.Name: Remove all special characters including spaces
Notes.Details: Uses a regex expression with replace to remove all characters that do not match the expression.

Notes.Name: Remove all special characters leaving spaces
Notes.Details: Uses a regex expression with replace to remove all characters that do not match the expression.

Notes.Name: Replace using Regular Expression
Notes.Snippet:
$string = 'Thank you for calling 555-5757 your order total is $123.32'
$string -Replace "[0-9]","0"
Notes.Details: Use the -Replace to Replace String using a regular expression

Notes.Name: Replace using plain text replacement
Notes.Snippet:
$string = 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'
$string.Replace("brown","red")
Notes.Details: Use the .Replace to Replace String using a plain text value
